label: 4. You all need to lighten up.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: You all need to lighten up.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Exia?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: How are we getting a signal?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Every wall can be breached.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: For someone as skilled as me, it wasn't too difficult.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: One little push, and the dominoes came toppling down.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Have you been watching us?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Hardly!

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I much prefer the term monitoring.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What's the difference?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I think you can trust

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Shifty.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: And why's that?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: She's at the max level in Final Quest.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What does a video game have to do with whether she can be trusted?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Nobody who plays Final Quest can be all that bad.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: This is the truth.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: If you disagree, then you don't know anything about games.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: We'll decide for ourselves if we can trust her or not.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Don't drag us into this! You're the paranoid one.
